crossRefs.note: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

parallels.note: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

translations.web: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
translations.bsb: And when He had said this, He showed them His hands and feet.
translations.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
translations.asv: And when he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
